scoring_justification: Checker recomputes reference driving forces from the paper's published regression formulas (Eqs. 11, 12, 20, 23) and compares to agent's computed values. Polynomial coefficients are compared to Eq. 11's coefficients. Both are recompute comparisons with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference driving force formulas for β'→α', β→α, β'→β₁'+α, α→α' and polynomial coefficients for ΔG^(β'→α').
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper equations (11), (12), (20), (23) from the source manuscript.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded algebraic formulas extracted verbatim from the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published regression results the paper reports as its main outcome; they are the natural hidden gold.

outputs.description: Driving forces for the four transformations at ten temperatures. Each value will be checked against the paper's published regression formulas within a small tolerance.
Cubic polynomial coefficients for ΔG^(β'→α')(T). Units: constant in J·mol⁻¹, T in J·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹, T2 in J·mol⁻¹·K⁻², T3 in J·mol⁻¹·K⁻³. Compared to Eq. (11) with small component tolerances.

output_contract.notes: All computations use explicit numeric parameters extracted from the paper. No gold values are provided to the agent. The hidden checker computes reference driving forces from the paper's regression formulas and compares with absolute tolerance 5 J·mol⁻¹; polynomial coefficients are compared component-wise with tolerances (constant ±0.1, T ±0.001, T² ±1e-5, T³ ±1e-7).

steps.description: Verify driving forces at 10 temperatures match paper Eqs. (11), (12), (20), (23) within 5 J·mol⁻¹ absolute tolerance.
Verify cubic regression coefficients for ΔG^(β'→α') match Eq. (11) within component tolerances (constant ±0.1, T ±0.001, T² ±1e-5, T³ ±1e-7).
